label: PISO4

semantics.notes: 4-bit Parallel-In Serial-Out register. LD=1 loads P0-P3 into bit0-bit3 on rising edge. LD=0 shifts left toward Q: q reflects bit0, bit0<-bit1, bit1<-bit2, bit2<-bit3, bit3<-0.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: verilogExtraRegs: sr[3:0] internal register. always @(posedge clk) if (load) sr<={p0,p1,p2,p3}; else sr<={sr[2:0],1'b0}; q reflects the shifted internal state.
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: process(clk) if rising_edge(clk) then if load='1' then sr<=p0 & p1 & p2 & p3; else sr<=sr(2 downto 0) & '0'; end if; end if; q reflects the shifted register state.

testability.notes: Verify parallel load: LD=1 + clk↑ loads P0-P3 into state. Verify shift: LD=0 + 4 clocks serially exposes P0,P1,P2,P3 on Q and then shifts in 0.

modelLimits: prevClk hidden state not exposed to STT.
